'''Calia''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:TTB" /> Around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> she was stationed at the [[Outpost Senth]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where she tasked a Republic citizen to fight the [[Terror Brigade]]'s [[Onslaught (Terror Brigade)|Onslaught]] in exchange for them handing over captured Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Yoren]].<ref name="TOR:TTB" />
